spec.title: Textstatistik
spec.summary: A zero-dependency Node.js library and CLI that reports word, character and line counts and the most frequent words in a text.
requirements: List the most frequent words, case-insensitive
Offer a command line interface that reads the text from its arguments

acceptanceCriteria.text: characters counts all characters and lines counts newline-separated lines
topWords(text, 1) returns [{ word: 'hej', count: 2 }] for 'Hej hej världen'
Empty text returns zero words and zero lines; non-string input throws TypeError
`node src/cli.js hej hej du` prints JSON containing "words":3 and exits 0; no arguments exits 1

exports.name: textStats
exports.signature: (text: string) => { words: number, characters: number, lines: number }

exports.name: topWords
exports.signature: (text: string, n: number) => { word: string, count: number }[]
exports.description: Most frequent words, lower-cased, ties alphabetical
